name: Browse products and add a phone to cart
description: Verifies the core shopping flow from the catalog into the cart.
steps: Click Add to cart on iPhone 17 Pro Max
expected: The iPhone appears in the cart with its displayed Naira price and the cart count increases to 1.

name: Search phones on mobile
description: Verifies the phone catalog can be searched and remains usable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the Shop page on mobile
Enter Galaxy in the search field
expected: Galaxy products are shown and unrelated products are filtered out.

name: Remove a phone from the cart
description: Verifies a product can be removed and the cart summary updates.
setup: Add iPhone 17 Pro Max to the cart
steps: Click the remove X beside the iPhone
expected: The phone is removed and the empty-cart state is displayed.

name: Submit the contact enquiry form
description: Verifies the contact form accepts customer requirements without navigating away.
steps: Enter a name and contact detail
Choose iPhone and enter a budget requirement
expected: The form remains on the contact page without a browser validation error.
